specimen: Single adult female FAFB specimen; snapshot630 as redistributed by Shiu etal.
input_domain: Only measured chemical-synapse count Connectivity, never signed model Excitatory x Connectivity. No genes, soma coordinates or independently established celltypes supplied by these twofiles.
selection: Hash metadata rootIDs to choose2048nodes, sortnumeric, use a separate hash to select20%querysources. No selection using connection counts or degrees. Exact IDs frozen before graphfeatures or scoring.
holdout: Delete ALL outgoing rows of querysources before any degree, shared-neighbor feature, embedding, fitting or copying-donor selection. Retain known incoming connections from nonquery sources only. Targets are the nonquery source set. Autapses excluded.
supervised_training_features: For each training source, exclude its own outgoing row too. Reciprocal features unchanged except unusedselfpair; common-input target norm removes that source; target-frequency offset is leave-one-source-out. Synthetic tests compare to explicit row deletion.

methods.global_frequency: Beta(1,1) smoothed global TRAIN nonself link frequency
methods.target_frequency: Beta(1,1) smoothed per-target TRAIN nonself link frequency
methods.incoming_degree_block: Quartiles of knownincomingdegree fitted onTRAIN sources, per-target observedfrequency shrunk by10pseudoobservations toward globaltargetfrequency. Exclude the targetselfpair from each block denominator.
methods.nearest_incoming_copy: PickTRAIN donor by cosine similarity of incoming connections from nonquerysources; copy observed outgoingbinaryprofile over same targetset, blend50/50 with TRAIN targetfrequency for finite logloss. Donors excluded self-target slot uses TRAIN targetfrequency. Ties by numericneuronID.
methods.reciprocity_logistic: L2=.001logistic residual over leave-one-source-out targetlogit frequency, using observed log1p reverse count and known log1p incomingdegree; no classbalancing
methods.shared_input_logistic: Same, adding observed shared-presynaptic-input cosine. Source-row-deleted context for EVERY supervisedtraining source; TRAIN-only featurestandardization.150L-BFGSiterations, no heldout tuning.

metrics: micro average_precision with exact tie groups
comparison: Same410querysources and1638targets for everymethod. Report everycontrol. Candidatewins only if APstrictlyhigher, loglossandBrierstrictlylower thaneachcontrol. No statisticalsignificanceclaim from onebrain.
zero_semantics: Among selected completedneurons, an absent pair in this published identifiedchemicalsynapse table is a recorded-snapshotzero. It is not provenbiologicalabsence, completehormonalsignaling coverage, or an unassayedneuronnegative. Sourceassumption is disclosed; synapsedetection/proofreadingerrors remain.
lifecycle: freeze metadata/schema/input/code/testhashes; predict after allsourceholdouts and commit everyforecast; score heldoutoutcomes once. Rawsourcealready on disk; this is standard maskeddevelopment, not prospective absent-truth acquisition.

sources.data_license: CC BY-NC4.0; underlying data terms distinct from MITmodelcode.

rejected_first_choice.finding: Published notebook requests numericadjacency from explicitlyprivate CATMAID. Public saved outputs are rasterheatmaps, not reliable measured counttables. No private access or image digitization attempted.

scope: Genericwithin-fly connectivity completion with observedincomingcontext, not a neuroendocrine-specific subset. Onebrain, no independentanimals/sex/speciesvalidation, no axongeometryscore or causalinterventionprediction.

transfer_admission.permitted: Reusable modelarchitecture, masking/evaluation and uncertainty algorithms only; structuralpretraining would need separatelytested mouseendpoints.
transfer_admission.prohibited: Appending fly connections to mousegraph, aligningneurons by genenamealone, importing flyweights/signs asmousegroundtruth, claimingage-reversal/actuatorvalidation.
